description: Viešoji įstaiga Statybos sektoriaus vystymo agentūra: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.lt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Viešoji įstaiga Statybos sektoriaus vystymo agentūra. Coverage: Viešoji įstaiga Statybos sektoriaus vystymo agentūra. The listing groups 10 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Potvynių rizikos zonos; prioritetinis duomenų rinkinys – Potvynių direktyva. Preliminarus potv; Potvynių grėsmės teritorijos (potvynio vandens lygiai); Potvynių grėsmės teritorijos (potvynio mastas). Formats seen: GML, GDB, GEOTIFF, SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nd/4.0/deed.lt). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-lt.
